title: Create a Microsoft Foundry resource
description: Basics on how to create a Microsoft Foundry resource
bodyHtml:
**Requirements**

You need an Azure subscription. If you don't have one, go to azure.microsoft.com/free and set one up, new accounts get a free credit for the first 30 days.

**Create a resource group**

First, In the search bar, type Resource groups and open that page. 

    - Click + Create  - Fill in:Subscription, your subscription - Resource group; something like rg-foundry-learning. - Region: pick one close to you, for example Sweden Central. - Click Review + create, then Create.

**Create the foundry resource**

    - Open the Azure portal and search for** **Foundry - Go to portal.azure.com and sign in. - Click the search bar at the top of the page and type Microsoft Foundry. - Under "Marketplace" in the results dropdown, look for the tile with publisher: Microsoft and type:Azure Service. - Select Microsoft Foundry

You can also skip the search and paste this directly into your browser: *portal.azure.com/#create/Microsoft.CognitiveServicesAIFoundry*. 
It drops you straight onto the form for the next step.

 

**Fill in the Foundry resource creation form.**

Back on the Microsoft Foundry marketplace page  click Create. You land on a creation blade with tabs across the top: 

    - Basics  - Storage - Inbound Networking - Outbound Networking - Identity - Encryption - Tags - Review + create

On the Basics tab, fill in:

    -  Subscription, same one you used for the** **resource group - Resource group: select the one you just created. - Region: match the region you picked for the resource group. - Name: has to be globally unique across Azure, since it becomes part of your resource's endpoint URL. Something like foundry-yourname-learning. - Default project name: Microsoft folds "create your first project" into this same form. Type something like foundry-xx-learning for now.

Leave the rest at their defaults for this first resource 

    - Storage , a storage account gets created automatically if you leave this blank. - Inbound Networking , defaults to public access (key or Entra ID authenticated). - Outbound Networking , default is fine. - Identity, default is fine. - Encryption, Microsoft-managed keys by default. - Tags are optional, skip for now.

Foundry resources bill pay-as-you-go for what you actually use.

**Review and create**

    - Click Review + create.  Wait for the green "Validation passed" banner. - Click Create.

Deployment takes one to two minutes. It's provisioning a resource of type** **Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts .When it finishes you'll see "Your deployment is complete", with a button "Go to resource".

See what you got

    - Click Go to resource first. This opens the resource's Overview page in the regular Azure portal, where you'll find information about The resource's Endpoint URL ETC and Standard Azure controls  - Click Go to Foundry portal .This takes you to ai.azure.com.  In the upper-left corner you'll see the project name you typed in the previous step already selected, because creating the resource created that project too.


That's it ,you have a** l**ive Foundry resource with a project!
